items: (used with verbs) closer (describing an action of approaching to an entity) — под- + идти́ (“to go (by walking)”) → подойти́ (“to walk up to, to approach (by walking)”)
(used with verbs) upwards (describing an action of moving from the bottom up) — под- + бро́сить (“to throw”) → подбро́сить (“to throw upwards”)
(used with verbs) adding (describing an action of adding more entity) — под- + -ба́вить → подба́вить (“to add, replenish”)

(used with verbs) (describing a meaning that shows a finished action or an obtainment of a result) — под- + писа́ть (“to write”) → подписа́ть (“to sign, to subscribe (in the sense of writing one's name with a result)”)
(used with verbs) (describing an action of copying or following someone's action) — под- + да (“yes”) + -кать + -ивать → подда́кивать (“to say yes, to assent (in the sense echoing "yes")”)

(used with verbs) (describing an existence of the certain action that is weak, invisible, hidden or incomplete) — под- + уста́ть (“to get tired”) → подуста́ть (“to get tired slightly or lightly”); под- + слать (“to send, dispatch”) → подосла́ть (“to send something (secretly)”)
